sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Inventory vs. Sales / COGS Trend: Inventory intensity changed +5.7 percentage points of total assets and inventory days moved +36 days. Stock is building faster than sales, a classic early warning of demand weakness or channel stuffing.
CFO vs. Net Income Conversion: Operating cash flow converted 49% of reported net profit. Profit is running ahead of cash generation, which points to working-capital or accrual quality issues.

Payout Ratio Sustainability: Dividends absorbed 65% of earnings against free cash flow of 18% of net profit. The payout is above what the business generates, so it depends on cash reserves or borrowing.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded 7.6% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.
